features.notes: The footprint is broader and the brick hierarchy is clearer, but the mass remains too tall and insufficiently stepped relative to the reference.
All six macro IDs are findable in the front and elevated views, though only about four read semantically without labels.
The oculus is recognizable and embedded, but it remains too small, front-facing, weakly elliptical, and lacks the striped surround.
The damaging B-shaped double lobe is gone and the shell is contiguous, but it remains a large blank cap without the defining continuous glass ribbon.
The isolated QA root still reads as a display stand; canonical terrain seating remains explicitly unproven.

nextAction: Add subject-specific stripe, glazing-ribbon, facade-opening, and podium rhythm systems before any canonical integration claim.
limitations: The official Tier-1 result remains rejected because its foreground masks and aspect handling measured background and framing rather than the subject.
No reference matte or official Tier-1 IoU pass exists yet.
Canonical terrain contact, portals, collision, LOD, partition behavior, and performance are not proven by this elevated presentation blockout.
GTA or Watch Dogs AAA parity is explicitly rejected.
